The Dungeon of Fellstone
Move up to 3 cells, then the tile you land on resolves
Dungeon tiles (49 on the board, 29 in the draw pile)
Room - nothing happens.
Rest - stop here and refresh your hand. The tile is then discarded.
Fellstone Wraith - Power 2 to 5. Play one combat card; ties go to you.
Beat it and it joins your hand as a combat card of that power. Lose and you take 1 damage, and it stays face up for the next player.
Traps
Pickpocket - steal a random card from another player's hand.
Cache - put a random card from your hand under this tile.
Snare - your next turn is skipped.
Wellspring - refresh your hand.
Collapse - every face-up tile within 3 cells is shuffled back and redealt face down, this one included.
Displacement - swap positions with another player.
Mage
1 Dodge - you lose no health this combat.
2 Counterspell - your opponent's ability does not resolve.
3 Hidden Blade - becomes Power 6 if your opponent's power is 4 or more.
4 Thunder Slash - +1 power per face-up monster tile adjacent to you.
5 Fireball - if you win, your opponent loses 2 health.
Paladin
1 Dodge - you lose no health this combat.
2 Defensive Stance - you win ties.
3 Hidden Blade - becomes Power 6 if your opponent's power is 4 or more.
4 Riposte - if you lose, your opponent also loses 1 health.
5 Authority - if you win, steal a random card from your opponent's hand.
Resolution
Player vs player - both cards are revealed together. The loser takes 1 damage; a tie costs both players 1 health.
Used cards go to your discard slot. When your hand is empty, the discard pile becomes your hand again.
Health starts at 4 on your d4. At 0 you are out. Last adventurer standing wins.
